tasks.label: Build HTML Customization
tasks.command: CUSTOMIZATION_PROJECT=$(node -e "const projects = require('./HTML/angular.json').projects; const matches = Object.entries(projects).filter(([name, project]) => name.startsWith('customization-') && project.projectType === 'library').map(([name]) => name); if (matches.length !== 1) { console.error('Expected exactly one customization library, found ' + matches.length + ': ' + (matches.join(', ') || 'none')); process.exit(1); } process.stdout.write(matches[0]);") && npm --prefix ./HTML/ run ng -- build "$CUSTOMIZATION_PROJECT" --configuration development
tasks.detail: Build the discovered customization library in development mode.
